slide_title_en: Wrong risk-ratio identity; correct P values
exact_excerpt: All 10 printed RRs and CIs reproduce as P(low arm | event)/P(low arm | no event), i.e., a transposed 2x2 table. P values (chi-square) are correct.
interpretation_en: The Notes locate the retained mechanism in the risk-ratio estimand and explicitly clear the P values.
explanation_zh: 风险比的条件方向被转置；备注明确指出 P 值正确，不能把这条记录再算作 P 值错误。

slide_title_en: Bleeding outcome rows carry each other’s statistics
exact_excerpt: Table 2 p.7: RR, CI and P for the two bleeding rows are swapped.
interpretation_en: The same RR/CI/P tuples are assigned to the wrong outcome rows; attribution is more specific than three separate arithmetic categories.
explanation_zh: 两种出血结局的 RR、CI、P 整组错置；主类别为结果归属，而非把同一候选项拆成三个问题。
notes_authorship: Earlier Claude Opus 5.5 high AI reviewer run

exact_excerpt: Main p4: follow-up imaging was MRI in 8 of 336 (2%) and CT in 328 (98%); p9 and eTable 11 (supp 5 p51; N 101+24+79=204) describe 204 (61%) patients with MR diffusion follow-up; p11 says 'two-thirds'.
interpretation_en: A population-accounting mechanism can be substantive; category does not determine severity.
explanation_zh: 同属人数/分母问题也可被最终人工复核判为 substantive；机制与严重性必须独立。

slide_title_en: Intervals labeled 95% behave like one-SE intervals
exact_excerpt: Printed P values reproduce almost exactly if each interval is estimate +/- 1 SE (r = 0.999 over rows with P>=.001; SE implied by P is 1.95 x the 95%-CI SE), so the 'CIs' are ~68% intervals.
interpretation_en: The Notes diagnose the reported confidence level, so method definition takes precedence over a generic CI/P disagreement.
explanation_zh: 备注给出的是置信水平标注机制，因此归入分析定义；最终 minor_presentation 标签照原样保留。
notes_authorship: Earlier Claude Opus 5.5 high AI reviewer run

slide_title_en: Broad asymmetry claim rejected; localized bound typo retained
exact_excerpt: Many RR intervals in Table 2 and eTables 8-9 are not symmetric on the log scale (Python check), but with an unstated derivation (C006) asymmetry is not itself an error. Demonstrable errors in these rows: adjusted self-report RR '2.8 (1.9 to 42)' (Table 2 p.6; 4.2 intended) and mixed precision '3.6 (2.14 to 6.87)'.
interpretation_en: The classification follows the explicit retained defect rather than the broad candidate title or an asymmetry keyword.
explanation_zh: 备注明确否定“仅凭不对称即可认定错误”，保留的是 42/4.2 的局部排印问题；不能按标题扩大指控。

slide_title_en: Retained interval repetition; comparator allegation rejected
exact_excerpt: The WOMAC total week-24 interval being narrower than a root-sum-of-squares of arm intervals is not by itself an error, since arm changes share model coefficients.
interpretation_en: The glucose interval repeats the identified hsCRP interval; the separate WOMAC concern is explicitly rejected. The repeated value does not independently prove a copying operation.
explanation_zh: 只保留葡萄糖区间与已定位的 hsCRP 区间重复这一归属问题；备注否定了另一条 WOMAC 区间宽度指控。
